info.title: deskhaven admin API
info.description: Backs the deskhaven web console. Authenticated operations need the console session cookie; their security requirement names the role they need (session: any console session, also one that must first change its password or enrol a required second factor; self: any console user, admin: admin or owner, owner: owner; a session with an unfinished account setup gets 403 `setup_required` outside `session` operations). Every state-changing request (not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS) must send the `X-Deskhaven-CSRF` header with the value of the `__Host-deskhaven_csrf` cookie (any non-empty value without a session); cross-site browser requests are refused. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}}` with a stable `code`.

patch.summary:
Changes and resets settings in one all-or-nothing batch (audited `setting.update`, or
`setting.reset` when it only resets). Every change names the `version` it was read at:
a stored row that moved on makes the batch a 409 `version_conflict` (nothing is
written; `details.conflicts` has the current settings of the stale keys). Pinned keys
are 409 `setting_pinned`; invalid values and violated cross-key rules are 422 with
`details.fields` keyed by setting key. A change that leaves the value as it is writes
nothing. Returns all settings, as after the batch.

parameters.description: The `__Host-deskhaven_csrf` cookie's value; any non-empty value without a session.

403.description: Role not allowed (`forbidden`), the account setup is unfinished (`setup_required`), or a missing or wrong CSRF header or a cross-site request (`csrf_failed`).

409.description: A key is pinned (`setting_pinned`, `details.keys`) or changed since it was read (`version_conflict`, `details.conflicts`)

422.description: Unknown key, invalid value, both or neither of `value` and `reset`, or a violated cross-key rule

429.description: Too many rejected sessions from this address (`rate_limited`).

The error envelope of an import refused for row problems (`code` is

ImportRowError.description:
A rejected row: its line, the offending column (if one) and a stable code: `columns`

ImportedUser.description: One created account and its temporary password (shown only here).

line.description: Line of the row in the CSV text.

cleared.description: Lockout counters removed (0: nothing was locked or counted).

oneOf.description:
Signed in: the session and CSRF cookies are set. When `user.setup_required` is set,
the session reaches only `/me`, the password change, the TOTP enrolment and logout
until that step is done.

The password was right and the account has TOTP: send a TOTP or recovery code with
this challenge to `POST /auth/login/totp` (valid 5 minutes, 5 codes). No cookie.

LoginResponse.description: The answer of a sign-in step.

ManagedByView.description: Who owns a resource: the console, or the configuration file (read-only here).

oneOf.description:
The account setup step this session must finish before anything else; `null` when
none. Until then only `/me`, the password change, the TOTP enrolment and logout
answer (others: 403 `setup_required`).

NewUserBody.description:
A new local account. Without `password` the server generates a temporary one, returns
it once and requires a change at first login.

must_change_password.description:

password always requires one.

password.description: An initial password chosen by the administrator (checked against the policy).

SessionView.description: A usable session of the user (no token).

rustdesk_id.description: Client sessions: the RustDesk id of the device.

SettingChangeBody.description: One requested change: a new `value`, or `reset` to drop the stored value (exactly one).

reset.description: Delete the stored value, so the default applies again.

version.description: The `version` of the setting as last read; a different stored version is a 409.

SettingKind.description: How the form edits a setting: the registry's value kinds.

SettingSchema.description: What a form needs to edit one setting (derived from the registry declaration).

SettingView.description: One setting with its effective value.

category.description: The first key segment: the form's group.

pinned.description: Fixed by the bootstrap configuration: not editable here.

version.description: Send back as `version` when changing or resetting the setting (0: nothing stored).

SettingsPatch.description: A batch of changes, applied together or not at all.

reason.description: Note stored in the history of every written key (at most 500 characters).

SetupRequest.description: The setup link's token and the owner to create. Never logged.

SetupStatus.description: Whether the first-run setup is still open.

public_url.description:
The configured `public_url` (bootstrap configuration, changed by a restart); `null`
when unset (OIDC and e-mail links need it).

SetupStep.description: The next account setup step of a console session.

oneOf.description: Pinned by the configuration file; read-only here.
Pinned by an environment variable (`<KEY>_FILE` included); read-only here.
Pinned by a command-line flag; read-only here.
Stored in the database (the setting was modified in the console).

by.description: Account that wrote it; none for the system or when the account is gone.

SourceView.description: Where the effective value comes from (05 §3.5).

StrategyLayerView.description: One strategy applying to the device.

target_id.description: The group, user or device group id; absent for `global`.

StrategyOptionView.description: One option of the merged result and the layer it comes from.

value.description: Empty: the client deletes the option.

StrategyScopeView.description: What a strategy is assigned to; later layers win.

TemporaryPassword.description: A generated temporary password, shown once.

code.description: A current six-digit code of the pending seed.

TotpEnabled.description: TOTP is enabled: the recovery codes (shown once) and the user.

qr.description: The URI as a QR code.

secret.description: The seed in base32, for manual entry.

TotpLoginRequest.description: The challenge of the password step and a code. Never logged.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP code, or a recovery code (`xxxxx-xxxxx`).

username.description: The username the password step was for.

UserCreated.description: A created account; `temporary_password` only when the server generated one (shown once).

UserDetail.description: One account with its groups and usable sessions (the console's user drawer).

UserPatch.description: Changes to an account; absent fields stay as they are.

email.description: An empty string removes the address. A new address is unverified.

UserView.description: A user account as administrators see it. Carries no secret.

console_session.name: __Host-deskhaven_session
console_session.description: Console session token (HttpOnly; set by the console login).
